Inclusion Criteria
Details 1. Patients aged 40-70 years of either gender with clinical diagnosis of OA knee. 2. Willing to give written informed consent.
ExclusionCriteria
Details 1. Severe joint deformity or requirement of immediate surgical intervention. 2. Concurrent systemic illness like uncontrolled diabetes or renal failure.
Primary Outcome
Outcome TimePoints
Reduction in WOMAC pain and disability score from baseline Week 4, Week 8, Week 12

Outcome TimePoints

Brief Summary This clinical trial evaluates the clinical efficacy, tolerability and safety of an Ayurvedic polyherbal formulation compared to placebo in patients suffering from mild to moderate knee osteoarthritis over a 12-week treatment duration.
